gauges.label: Soft-deleted vaults blocking name
gauges.detail: kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 holds the globally unique name until recovered or purged

gauges.label: Soft-delete retention remaining
gauges.detail: Recoverable window before scheduled purge; purge protection blocks early purge

blocks.title: Can't Recreate Key Vault After Deletion · Control-Plane Evaluation Chain

hops.detail: kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 found deleted in rg-contoso-finance-prod; name remains reserved
Name is already in use in soft-deleted state — recreation cannot proceed
Remove-AzKeyVault -InRemovedState purge is blocked until retention expires; data must be preserved
Restores the original vault, URI, policies, secrets, keys and certificates

blocks.title: Vaults in rg-contoso-finance-prod — soft-delete inventory
Recover soft-deleted vault instead of recreate
blocks.diff:
- # Fails: VaultAlreadyExists — name held by soft-deleted vault
- New-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod' -Location 'eastus'
+ # Verify soft-deleted state across vaults in the subscription
+ $deleted = Get-AzKeyVault -InRemovedState | Where-Object { $_.VaultName -eq 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' }
+ $deleted | Select-Object VaultName, ResourceGroupName, Location, DeletionDate, ScheduledPurgeDate
+ # Purge protection is enabled and data must be preserved — do NOT purge
+ # Recover the original vault with its secrets, keys, certs and policies
+ Undo-AzKeyVaultRemoval -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod' -Location $deleted.Location
+ # Verify recovery
+ Get-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod'
+ Get-AzKeyVaultSecret -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' | Select-Object Name, Enabled

blocks.title: Can't Recreate Key Vault After Deletion · Audit & Activity Log

events.detail: kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 deleted from rg-contoso-finance-prod; entered 90-day soft-deleted state
Recreation failed: vault name is already in use in soft-deleted state
Early purge denied by purge protection; recovery via Undo-AzKeyVaultRemoval is the supported path

recommendedActions.label: Recover soft-deleted vault
recommendedActions.description: Run Undo-AzKeyVaultRemoval to restore kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 with all secrets, keys, certs and access policies intact.

recommendedActions.label: Inspect soft-deleted vaults
recommendedActions.description: List all soft-deleted vaults and confirm deletion/purge dates before recovery; also available via az keyvault list-deleted.
recommendedActions.command: Get-AzKeyVault -InRemovedState | Format-Table VaultName, ResourceGroupName, Location, DeletionDate, ScheduledPurgeDate; az keyvault list-deleted --query "[?name=='kv-contoso-fin-prod-01']" -o table

cardTemplate.title: Can't recreate my Key Vault after deleting the old one
cardTemplate.headline: kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 is soft-deleted with purge protection — its name is reserved, so recover it to rg-contoso-finance-prod instead of recreating or purging.
cardTemplate.reason: No existing catalog element covers Key Vault soft-delete name reservation and recover vs purge workflow for kv-contoso-fin-prod-01

blocks.title: Can't recreate my Key Vault after deleting the old one · Resource & State Metrics

gauges.label: Name reservation (kv-contoso-fin-prod-01)
gauges.detail: 1 soft-deleted vault holds the globally unique name; recreation in same region returns name conflict

gauges.label: Soft-delete retention remaining
gauges.detail: Deleted vault retained for 90 days until scheduled purge unless recovered

gauges.label: Purge protection block
gauges.detail: enablePurgeProtection=true — permanent purge is denied during retention; recovery is the supported path

blocks.title: Can't recreate my Key Vault after deleting the old one · Control-Plane Evaluation Chain

hops.detail: Vault moved to soft-deleted state; keys, secrets and certificates remain recoverable and name stays reserved
New-AzKeyVault / az keyvault create fails because soft-deleted vault with same name already exists
az keyvault purge is blocked while purge protection is enabled and retention has not expired
Undo-AzKeyVaultRemoval / az keyvault recover restores vault, access policies and objects to original resource group

blocks.title: Soft-deleted vault inventory — kv-contoso-fin-prod-01
Recover (not purge/recreate) the soft-deleted vault
blocks.diff:
- # Recreate fails: name already exists / reserved
- New-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod' -Location 'eastus'
+ # Verify soft-deleted state (purge protection blocks purge)
+ Get-AzKeyVault -InRemovedState | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' }
+ az keyvault list-deleted --query "[?name=='kv-contoso-fin-prod-01']"
+ # Recover the old vault to its original resource group (chosen strategy)
+ Undo-AzKeyVaultRemoval -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod' -Location 'eastus'
+ # Azure CLI equivalent:
+ # az keyvault recover --name kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 --resource-group rg-contoso-finance-prod
+ # Verify recovery
+ Get-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod'
+ az keyvault show --name kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 --resource-group rg-contoso-finance-prod --query properties.provisioningState

blocks.title: Can't recreate my Key Vault after deleting the old one · Audit & Activity Log

events.detail: kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 deleted from rg-contoso-finance-prod (eastus) and moved to soft-deleted state with purge protection
Recreate with same name and region failed: a soft-deleted vault with name kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 already exists
az keyvault list-deleted confirms vault is recoverable; purge denied until retention expires, recovery recommended

recommendedActions.label: Recover soft-deleted vault
recommendedActions.description: Restore kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 with its keys, secrets, certificates and policies to rg-contoso-finance-prod in eastus
recommendedActions.command: Undo-AzKeyVaultRemoval -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod' -Location 'eastus'; az keyvault recover --name kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 --resource-group rg-contoso-finance-prod

recommendedActions.label: Inspect soft-deleted state
recommendedActions.description: Confirm deletion date, scheduled purge date and purge-protection status before recovery
recommendedActions.command: Get-AzKeyVault -InRemovedState | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' }; az keyvault list-deleted --query "[?name=='kv-contoso-fin-prod-01']" -o table
